_note: Verified source map for the City of Austin stance wave (probed 2026-08-19). Every URL here returned HTTP 200 with the stated story count on page 1 — none are guessed. Austin Monitor tag slugs are irregular: Watson's is a STALE 'state-senator-' label from his Texas Senate days, Ellis and Harper-Madison carry a 'council-member-' prefix, and Vela's uses his full 'jose-chito-vela' form. Do not guess these; they were found by scraping tag links out of article markup after 4 of 11 guessed slugs 404'd.

_sources_ruled_out.legistar_api: https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/austintexas — agenda index ONLY. /eventitems/{id}/votes returns [], /matters/{id}/sponsors returns [], /matters/{id}/histories returns 0 rows, and 0 of 30 published 2025 council meetings carry a minutes file. Proves an instrument exists; carries NO attribution. Cannot seat a chair on its own.
_sources_ruled_out.austintexas_gov_district_pages: https://www.austintexas.gov/district-N — ~4-5k chars, all site chrome, zero positional content.
_sources_ruled_out.austin_monitor_onsite_search: https://austinmonitor.com/?s= — returns unrelated results; use the tag archives below instead.

message_board.access: Incapsula WAF — curl gets a JS interstitial at HTTP 200. Playwright passes.
message_board.caveat: Posting is open to council members AND authorized staff. Staff posts are quarantined to _staff-authored/ and must never be attributed to a member. Some staff write in the officeholder's first-person voice: the Mayor's chief of staff (Colleen Pate, 240 topics) opens threads as 'I' and members reply 'Mayor, ...'. That is evidence ABOUT Watson, not a quote FROM him.
message_board.quirk: viewtopic.php IGNORES ?start= and viewforum.php CLAMPS it — both re-serve a page rather than returning empty, so any offset loop must terminate on 'no new ids', never on an empty batch.

ballotpedia_candidate_connection._note: Detector warning: EVERY Ballotpedia page contains the boilerplate strings 'Candidate Connection' and 'Campaign themes', so testing for those returns a uniform true and is a BROKEN detector. The discriminating signal is a real 'Key messages' block. Positive control: Mike_Siegel (first-person climate prose). Negative control: Kirk_Watson (nothing). 'has not yet completed' also appears on both and is likewise boilerplate.
ballotpedia_candidate_connection.access: Cross-origin fetch is CORS-blocked; navigate to the origin first, then same-origin fetch.
